Will servicing here affect my warranty?
No. As long as it is serviced to schedule with the right parts, a manufacturer warranty stands — that has been the law across Europe since 2003.
Do you use genuine parts?
Where it matters, yes. Where a good aftermarket part is the same thing in a different box, we will offer you both prices and let you choose.
Can I wait while it is done?
For anything under an hour, yes — there is a kettle and a chair. For longer jobs most people drop the car off before eight.
